_finding: The footer's Glama badge is somebody else's SVG served from our origin (24.11). Opened on its own an SVG is a document, so a script, an event handler, a foreignObject or a link out inside it would run or load as us. The danger is a filter that lets one of them through, a failed read that drops the good copy, or a server that asks Glama on every request.

mutations.name: event handlers are no longer looked for
mutations.expect: FAIL refused: an event handler in capitals

mutations.name: a link may leave the file
mutations.expect: FAIL refused: a link out under another namespace prefix

mutations.name: a url() may leave the file
mutations.find: if (!/^#[\w.-]+$/.test(m[1])) return why('a url() out of the file')
mutations.replace: if (false) return why('a url() out of the file')
mutations.expect: FAIL refused: a url() out of the file

mutations.name: a DOCTYPE or entity is let through
mutations.find: if (/<[!?]/.test(s)) return why('a DOCTYPE, entity, comment or processing instruction')
mutations.replace: if (/<\?/.test(s)) return why('a DOCTYPE, entity, comment or processing instruction')
mutations.expect: FAIL refused: a markup declaration inside the svg

mutations.name: a failed read throws away the last good copy
mutations.expect: FAIL a refused read keeps the last good copy, and says why in the journal

mutations.name: the server asks Glama on every refresh
mutations.find: if (!force && now() - tried < everyMs) return Promise.resolve()
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and the server asks again only after an hour

mutations.name: any content type is taken as a badge
mutations.find: if (!/^image\/svg\+xml\b/i.test(res.headers?.get?.('content-type') || '')) throw new Error('badge is not image/svg+xml')
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new Error('badge is not image/svg+xml')
mutations.expect: FAIL a read that is not image/svg+xml is refused

mutations.name: the size cap is lifted
mutations.find: if (buf.length > max) throw new Error(`badge too large (${buf.length} bytes)`)
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new Error(`badge too large (${buf.length} bytes)`)
mutations.expect: FAIL a read past the size cap is refused

mutations.name: the badge's own CSP allows scripts
mutations.find: export const GLAMA_BADGE_CSP = "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:"
mutations.replace: export const GLAMA_BADGE_CSP = "default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:"
mutations.expect: FAIL the badge is served under a CSP that runs no script and fetches nothing

mutations.name: escapes and character references are let through
mutations.find: if (/[\\]|&#|image-set/i.test(s)) return why('an escape, a character reference or image-set')
mutations.replace: if (/image-set/i.test(s)) return why('an escape, a character reference or image-set')
